title: Study title

hypothesis.null_or_counter_hypothesis: State the null or competing explanation.
hypothesis.primary_outcome: Specify the primary outcome and exact calculation.
hypothesis.failure_criterion: Specify in advance what result would fail to support the hypothesis.

scope.universe_selection_rule: Describe universe construction and any survivorship limitations.

protocol.decision_timing: Specify which information is available at each decision time.
protocol.splitting_method: Specify chronological train/validation/test or another justified design.
protocol.baseline: Specify the baseline and why it is meaningful.
protocol.parameter_search: Describe all tested variants, ranges, and multiplicity handling.
protocol.cost_model: Describe fees, spread, slippage, funding, latency, liquidity, and fill assumptions.

data.timestamp_policy: Specify UTC event-time rules and data availability.
data.rights_note: State use and redistribution rights or unresolved limitations.

evaluation.uncertainty_method: Specify uncertainty intervals or why not applicable.
evaluation.out_of_sample_policy: Specify how held-out data is protected from selection.

limitations: Proposal template only; no study has been executed.

change_log.change: Created from the empirical study template.
change_log.rationale: Require explicit scope, bias review, negative findings, and reproducibility.
